ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: Figure 5 is a schematic diagram of the causes of natural conditions. In the middle of the figure from top to bottom, words such as “deep inland location,” “arid climate,” and “strong solar radiation” can be seen. Therefore, the answer is “fertile soil.”

<image1>

The grapes in the area shown are especially sweet. What local soil condition is this related to?
